remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. O'Keeffe traveled to Peru in 1956. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Smooth, softly shaded stones come together to form a wall that fills the composition. The rocks vary greatly in size and shape. The image depicts a wall at Sacsayhuaman, an ancient Incan citadel in Peru.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Sacsayhuaman)
